Coverage_Description: Multi-claim critical illness and life coverage up to 1100% of basic sum assured; covers 127 conditions (childhood, early-stage, severe and ICU), with severe illness extension to age 86 and death cover after a severe CI claim
customer requirement: Medical underwriting; for 挚爱宝, applicant must be pregnant at least 20 weeks at application
price structure: Premium is risk-based (age, sex, smoking, nationality, residence) and depends on policy currency and payment term; rates may be reviewed annually
additional informations: Participating basic plan; HKD/USD currency; premium payment terms 5/10/15/20/25 years (挚爱宝: 10-year)
